Grinex, a Russia-linked, Kyrgyzstan-incorporated exchange, suffered a coordinated hot wallet key compromise on April 15,16, 2026. Roughly $13.74M to $15M in USDT was drained from dozens of operational wallets across Tron and Ethereum, swapped into TRX within minutes, and consolidated at a single Tron address. No funds were recovered. Attribution claims of Western state sponsorship remain unsupported. Simultaneous signing authority over multiple hot wallets was compromised, allowing an attacker to rapidly drain funds across two chains. The precise entry vector is unverified, but forensic evidence supports loss via operational key compromise rather than a contract bug.
